subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for Gemini visible textSignature values on same-route Google history?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally replay valid same-route signatures, while the issue shows that unbounded visible-text signatures can bloat sessions and abort channel replies; changing this safely requires provider semantics ownership.

options.title: Bound visible-text signatures
options.body: Preserve required thinking/tool-call signatures but drop, cap, or externalize visible textSignature values before session replay.

options.title: Keep current replay
options.body: Accept ongoing session bloat risk in exchange for preserving every current same-route Gemini signature.

options.title: Split policy first
options.body: Open a narrower design issue for Google signature retention and keep this issue blocked until that policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Bound visible-text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required thinking/tool-call signatures but drop, cap, or externalize visible textSignature values before session replay.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent related commits span the direct Gemini reasoning fix and earlier Google signature-bloat merge, making them the best available routing owner from the history inspected.
